name: CIMC Vehicles (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: CIMC Vehicles (Group) Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, sells, and services semi-trailers worldwide. The company engages in the wholesale and retail of vehicles, auto parts, and metal materials; processing and manufacture of general mechanical products; and metal structures and related businesses. It also provides chassis, tractors, related spare parts, trailers and accessories, auto parts, containers, folding containers, tank containers, composite material products, tank trucks, and automobile trailers.
